justification: Strict weight loading and independent reconstruction of all 180 control input records and 60 window scores passed. Necessary control sensitivity passed on A05. This permits only broader already-rated calibration, not quality qualification.
known_contrary_evidence: Before this sweep, original A09 scores higher than A05 despite the reverse R1 synchronization ordering. A05's first two-second window also improves under a gross advance while its three-window average falls. Fine shifts are nonmonotonic. Do not tune away these findings.
scope: Exactly twelve unique seed2026090803 originals, A01..A12 in fixed order, one three-window evaluation per clip (36 forward passes). A05/A09 are repeatability anchors against the prior control run. No shifted, muted or tonal variants; no other seeds or held-out clips.
profile: Unchanged strict prefix-mapped FATE-derived model, adapter, source, dependencies, full-frame 336x336 bilinear resize, native 24 fps, explicit 32->48 kHz sinc/Hann audio resampling, valid-mask guard, upstream 48->50 feature alignment, FP32 parameters and BF16 autocast, batch one, four CPU threads, seed20260909. No training, new thresholds, window selection, gain change or score inversion.
measurement: Primary and only ranking metric: equal mean of the three raw window cosine-diagonal means, higher is better. Preserve all window/diagonal values but do not search them for a more favorable ranking. These contextual features are not event-onset detections or probabilities.
comparison: After inference, join by verified original media SHA-256 to all fourteen R1 entries. Preserve the shared A05 and A09 entries and their different contextual labels. Within each original seven-entry pairing enumerate all 21 unordered synchronization comparisons. Report concordant, discordant, model-tied, human-tied, both-tied and missing counts; descriptive (concordant+0.5*model-tied)/human-untied-eligible only. No pooling shared clips as independent, significance claims, overall-quality substitution, population inference or mapping raw scores to 0..4.
privacy: Inference receives only processed audio/video tensors; no labels, notes, prompt, merge names or paths. All computation local/offline, no uploads. Read human labels only in the post-inference comparison.
runtime: Validate all twelve sources before loading CUDA weights. Verify existing ComfyUI8189 queue empty and >=20 GiB free; queue guard before each window. Stop evaluator on occupied/unknown queue, never mutate the generation session.
stop_rule: One complete original-only sweep, followed by independent CPU reconstruction. Do not rerun or tune to improve agreement. Preserve mechanical failures separately. Poor or mixed agreement means this score is unsuitable for current autotuner ranking. Even strong descriptive agreement would not establish generalization or authorize automatic held-out admission.
